tools.name: eol_latest_release
tools.description: What is the latest version of a product right now? Returns the newest release cycle, its latest patch version and date, release date, support status and end-of-life date. Live data avoids out-of-date answers about "the latest Python/Node/PostgreSQL". Source: endoflife.date (community-maintained, typ

tools.name: eol_unsupported_releases
tools.description: Which versions of a product are already end of life? Lists the release cycles past their end-of-life date, newest first, with the end-of-life date, the last patch version and whether extended (often paid) support is still available. Useful for security audits and spotting outdated versions in an est

tools.name: eol_products_by_category
tools.description: List the products endoflife.date tracks in one category: operating systems, databases, programming languages, frameworks, server applications, cloud services, applications, devices or standards. Returns each product slug, name, aliases and tags so you can then look up release dates. Source: endoflif

tools.name: eol_products_by_vendor_tag
tools.description: List the products endoflife.date tracks under one tag, usually a vendor (microsoft, amazon, google, oracle, red-hat), a family (linux-distribution) or a runtime (php-runtime, javascript-runtime). Answers "which Microsoft products have end-of-life dates" before you look up each one. Source: endoflife

tools.name: eol_product_search
tools.description: Find the endoflife.date product slug for an everyday name or alias ("postgres", "k8s", "node", "windows server") and check whether a product is tracked at all. Matches names, labels and aliases and returns the best matches first. Use it before the other end-of-life tools. Source: endoflife.date prod

tools.name: eol_tags
tools.description: List every tag endoflife.date uses to group products: vendors (microsoft, amazon, google), families (linux-distribution) and runtimes (php-runtime, java-runtime). Use it to find a valid tag for eol_products_by_vendor_tag. Source: endoflife.date; tags are the project's own grouping, not an official v
